title: Yellowed Crispy Middle Eastern Cauliflower Kebabs
description: A resinous and crispy Middle Eastern dish featuring coriander seeds and nuka-pickle, perfect for a festive occasion. This ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection on a raclette-grill.
instructions: Preheat the raclette-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coriander seeds, nuka-pickle, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cauliflower florets to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated cauliflower onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the raclette-grill and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the cauliflower is tender and lightly browned.
Increase the heat to 425 degrees Fahrenheit and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cauliflower is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the grill and serve hot.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
